html:
Zapotec lawyer from Oaxaca who became president of Mexico and led it through civil war and foreign invasion. He was Mexico's first Indigenous president.

Born in a mountain village, he was orphaned young and spoke little Spanish until he was about twelve. He trained as a lawyer and became governor of Oaxaca. The dictator Santa Anna sent him into exile in New Orleans in 1853.

Back in power with the Liberals, he led the Reform:

  • The Juárez Law of 1855 ended the special courts of the church and army.
  • The Liberal constitution of 1857 followed.
  • In the Reform War of 1858 to 1861 the Liberals beat the Conservatives, and church lands were sold off.

When Mexico stopped paying its foreign debts, France invaded and made the Austrian archduke Maximilian emperor in 1864. Juárez kept his government alive in the north. After the French left, Maximilian was captured and shot in 1867. Juárez stayed president until he died in office in 1872.
sum: Zapotec lawyer from Oaxaca who became president of Mexico and led it through civil war and foreign invasion. He was Mexico's first Indigenous president.
